summary: Antler is actively accepting applications for its global in-person Residency, with public 2026 cohort starts across the US, APAC, Europe, and Africa.

proposed_event.name: Antler Residency 2026
proposed_event.description: Global in-person founder residency with coaching, co-founder matching and potential pre-seed investment.

dates.date_range_text: Applications can be started anytime. Upcoming 2026 cohorts listed include US July 1, Singapore/Indonesia July 20, Australia July 27, Germany September 14, UK September 22, and Kenya October 5; the cohort-start page also describes US as rolling intake.

sources.title: Apply to Antler | Further, Faster
sources.supports: Official application page says founders can apply online, choose a residency location, applications can secure a place at any time, and lists upcoming 2026 cohort starts including US July 1, Singapore/Indonesia July 20, Australia July 27, Germany September 14, UK September 22, and Kenya October 5.

sources.title: Cohort Start Dates | Antler Residency
sources.supports: Official cohort date page says listed dates are start dates rather than deadlines, encourages early applications, and lists upcoming locations/cities/cohorts including US rolling intake, Singapore, Indonesia, Australia, Germany, UK, and Kenya.

sources.title: Antler in the US | Further, Faster
sources.supports: Official US location page describes Antler as an inception-stage investor, states the Residency is in person in NYC, SF, and Austin, reviews applications year-round, runs for up to 3 months, and mentions typical initial commitment and partner credits.

notes: The official apply page lists a US July 1, 2026 cohort start, while the official cohort-start page currently says US has rolling intake; date_range_text captures both rather than inventing a deadline.
No application deadline is published on the official pages reviewed, so application_close is null.
Program end dates and demo day dates were not published for the global Residency listing.
